name: Baked Mac and Cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil macaroni in water with half the salt, stopping 2 minutes before the packet time, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in flour and cook gently for 2 minutes without browning.
Whisk in milk gradually. Simmer for 5 minutes until it coats a spoon, then turn off the heat and stir in most of the cheddar, paprika, pepper and remaining salt.
Combine sauce and macaroni in a baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs; bake 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
tips: Keep the sauce loose before baking because the pasta absorbs liquid in the oven.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
